message: 関東煮でしゅ

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena, who somehow ended up completely fading into the background along with her sister\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Background...? Sis, we were acting separately from Synn-kun to investigate all sorts of things, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's that, and this is this」

name: Helena
message: 「For my beloved boobs to suffer such a miserable fate, they must have been lacking in size」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's bulk them up so we never get reduced to mere academy scenery again. And, heeere we go~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahn, no... n-not there... hyahn!? D-Don't look, everyone...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you tell us not to look, Helena-san was the one who called the Crusaders here」

name: Misa
message: 「So, Helena-san, what is your business with us?」

name: Azel
message: 「Just some mundane errands」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why is Azel here? Are you going to help the Crusaders too?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Something like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so glad. My feelings have finally gotten through to you」

name: Azel
message: 「No, they haven't」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone is here now. Then, Helena, let's hear what you have to say--」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that person... Soltia-san, not coming?」

name: Azel
message: 「That woman returned to the Demon World and is recuperating there」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-The Demon World!?」

name: Azel
message: 「A mere Demon General simply misjudged her own capabilities. Pity is unnecessary」

name: Azel
message: 「Though, speaking of that, I too...」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan, there's no need to fear or regret failure. You just have to make sure you don't make the same mistake twice」

name: Ria
message: 「Nnh, stop... haah! S-Sis, those are actually nice words, so please don't say them while doing this!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my♪ Ufufu, what sort of thing do you mean by 'this'? Go on and say it with that cute little mouth of yours」

name: Ria
message: 「No... ngh, stop... noooo... ahn, ah... aaaahhhn」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, I would like to get to the main topic soon...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haah~, I'm starting to feel hungry」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah, feed us snacks!」

name: Helena
message: 「Looky here, is it right here? Does this feel good? Want more, do ya want me to do more?」

name: Ria
message: 「Haah, haah, haah... hah, kyuun! N-No, big sis... if you keep doing that, I'll... I-I'll... nnnnnn!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, Senpai's in big trouble! Misa, don't you think it's about time we covered Synn's eyes and ears?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're right」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Melilot, are these guys always like this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Quiet, please! Ahem... I shall explain in Helena's stead」

name: Helena
message: 「Hold on there, Melilot-kun, isn't that supposed to be my role?」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, members of the Crusaders! The time for the decisive battle is near. Listen closely to my major announcement!」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone, everyone! There was a huge earthquake last night, right? That was actually Melilot's fault!」

name: Melilot
message: 「H-Hey, Helena! You promised you'd keep quiet about that!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Fofofofo, trusting a verbal promise is way too naive of you, Melilot-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san. I've got a good hoe and plow, so I can lend them to you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was not trying to plow the ground with magic! I was trying to contain Re-Crea to a minimum!」

name: Melilot
message: 「During that process, the manifestation and misfire of Re-Crea caused the earth around Finis Tower to uplift...」

name: Misa
message: 「And as a result, there was an earthquake?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, if Re-Crea only caused that much damage, aren't we super lucky?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it is not over yet」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, in fact, it's only just begun. Heehee, no need to panic, though」

name: Helena
message: 「Thanks to having Azel-chan act as a spy in secret from everyone, we've started to see the truth behind this Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「Th... That's right, I am a covert agent」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ohhh, so that's why you wouldn't play with me」

name: Azel
message: 「That's not it!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Behind Re-Crea lurks a faction of the Demon Generals. The mastermind is a man of the Demon Heavens named Virus」

name: Melilot
message: 「According to Soltia, he has already come to the Human World」

name: Helena
message: 「Apparently, he possesses top-class strength even among the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Helena
message: 「He's quite sharp-witted, too. To think he laid a magic circle across all of Ryuusei Town to amplify Re-Crea's power」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold on a sec. If he does something like that, the Human World itself is gonna collapse, ain't it?」

name: Shio
message: 「We cannot leave this unchecked! Let us go destroy that magic circle at once!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine. As for that, Melilot has already neutralized it」

name: Misa
message: 「...I wonder why this person named Virus would go so far?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's the eerie part」

name: Melilot
message: 「His objective alone remains unknown. Only one fact is clear」

name: Melilot
message: 「That Virus is attempting to use Re-Crea as a means to achieve his goal」

name: Melilot
message: 「And we have no idea where in the void that power of Re-Crea is currently wandering」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm... So, putting Virus aside for a moment, does that mean we've at least succeeded in averting Re-Crea?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, shooting stars continue to fall. This fact is the clearest proof that Re-Crea still exists」

name: Melilot
message: 「I erased the amplification magic circle, yet the enlarged power of Re-Crea remains as it was」

name: Melilot
message: 「The power was merely released into the night sky, and the danger of the Human World collapsing still remains」

name: Azel
message: 「We cannot afford to let our guard down」

name: Azel
message: 「Originally, Re-Crea was something like a natural phenomenon accompanied by an impulse for destruction」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, this time, I sense a certain will within Re-Crea itself, distinct from mere impulse.」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is likely the result of an artificial element intervening during the capture, amplification, and final release of that power.」

name: Helena
message: 「I haven't been able to get a handle on Virus's movements either.」

name: Helena
message: 「However, even in this unclear situation, one thing is certain... Synn-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」

name: Helena
message: 「The only thing capable of standing against both Re-Crea and Virus now is the power of the Demon Lord.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm counting on great things from you, who are training to obtain your true power as the Demon Lord, and from all of you in the Crusaders supporting Synn-chan!」

name: Helena
message: 「That is all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you very much for your attention.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, how exciting. I have high expectations too. Is the oden not ready yet?」

name: Azel
message: 「I ate it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, no waaaay!? A-All of it?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph, naturally. It was miso oden.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Hic*, *sob*! Waaaaaah!」

name: Sally
message: 「*Sniff*, *sob*. Waaaaaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Roro-chan, Sally-chan. Come on, you don't have to bawl your eyes out.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is an old saying: 'To weep while slicing horse sashimi.' Lolotte must be craving cherry meat.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's cherry meat? A friend of beefsteak?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Hic*, *sniff*. Azel-san, if you're going to say that, it's 'adding honey to a crying face.'」

name: Sally
message: 「Honey, mitsumame, I wanna eat sweet, yummy snacks! Waaah! *flail, flail*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't both of those proverbs completely wrong?」

name: Ria
message: 「*Pant, pant, pant*... Ahhn, I'm beat...」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? Lady Ria's skin has turned a cherry-blossom pink.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, let's see?」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't look!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hwaaaah!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「A good trend. While manifesting immense magic power, you are heightening your concentration without being swept away by it」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, because there's just the right amount of tension」
The training ground moved from in front of the library to the plaza on the high hill.
I don't feel like I've gotten stronger myself, but apparently Melilot-san's barrier can no longer withstand the Demon Lord's attacks.
So, to prevent any damage if offensive magic strayed in an unexpected direction, we needed to move to a wide-open area.
Choosing somewhere still within the same academy is so like Melilot-san.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun……」
A short distance away where she wouldn't get in the way of training, there was Misa.
Thanks to that, my mind sharpens. Constantly paying attention so stray magic doesn't hit Misa, I take aim.

name: Melilot
message: 「You have achieved remarkable growth as the Demon Lord. However……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's take a break. It looks like Christeles-san has brought us some black tea」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's good!」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, I knew for sure you'd say that」
In the midwinter night air, we sit on the lawn and enjoy hot black tea.
Misa pours the black tea brewed in a large thermos into cups and hands them to Melilot-san and Paqy.

name: Melilot
message: 「What a lovely aroma. You used high-grade tea leaves, didn't you. However, there is also a faintly sweet scent……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh? I understand the sugar, but why strawberry jam?」

name: Misa
message: 「I am compelled to admit, to no small degree, the fact that I am not averse to thinking that black tea with jam dissolved in it is also quite delicious」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, since you came all this way to bring us refreshments, you could be more――」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're wrong! I didn't endure the dark and scary night to go around searching for you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh……」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll walk you back」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank----m-mind your own business! Sakura-kun, you have your Demon Lord training, don't you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Here, if you understand, then eat these honey-pickled lemons」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing, you made that too? You're just like a sports club manager.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't get the wrong idea. I--」

name: Synn
message: 「Your hobby is taking nighttime walks alone with a thermos full of delicious black tea and sweet-and-sour honey-soaked lemons in both hands, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right. So you do get it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hey, Misa, do you still have mixed feelings about me being the Demon Lord?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I don't!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Let me make this clear--I never had any issue with it in the first place!」

name: Misa
message: 「What I hated was that you were keeping secrets from me. You being the Demon Lord or whatever has nothing to do with it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you don't hate me anymore, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh...?! I-I don't... hate you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then do you love me? Including the part about me being the Demon Lord.」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of course I do... I-I, um, l-l-l...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Staaare--」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is the matter? Please pay no mind to my searing gaze and continue. This is truly fascinating.」

name: Misa
message: 「It puts my mind at ease knowing you're the Demon Lord, Sakura-kun.」

name: Misa
message: 「Because it's you... If you're the Demon Lord, I know everything will be alright.」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you have any complaints about that, Melilot-san?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Just what I'd expect from the Demon Lord's companion.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Remember how I once told you that Synn-sama resembles the first Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course. Back then, I was really down about things with Misa and being the Demon Lord...」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that supposed to mean? You should've just come clean right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... uh... I―I lo―」

name: Melilot
message: 「Staaare」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Both Hisu and Hikky, and Ria-chan and the rest of the gang, are the spitting image of our comrades back then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?! You remembered what happened back then!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You bet! Though, well, only in fragments.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That Re-Crea was massive, too. Not just the Human World--all Three Worlds were on the brink of returning to nothingness.」

name: Paqy
message: 「On top of that, even though each world knew the danger, they couldn't band together.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure, demons, angels, and humans don't get along, right? But what's the point of bickering right up until you're wiped out?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Amidst all that, the one who stood up to save the world was the First Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, it wasn't just the Demon Lord alone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Comrades from all three races who shared the same resolve banded together and protected the Three Worlds from the Re-Crea.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And after that, for the future of each world, an eternal pact was forged.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon Lord would leave behind his bloodline, the angels would entrust their souls to humans, and the humans would continue to protect them...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course, a long time passed and the promise started fading away... but in Synn-sama's generation, it was brilliantly revived!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong, going all quiet? Oh, I get it--you're so moved by my story you're speechless.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's that too, but there's a piece missing from your story just now, isn't there?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not really?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's missing is the part about you, Paqy.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right! I finally understand. Paqy-san, you're still alive so that you can give us advice like this, aren't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-I wouldn't know anything about that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee. You're always saying nothing but weird things, yet you really are wonderful, Paqy-san.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, getting praised by a hysteric like you doesn't make me happy at all! The great me only has eyes for Ria-chan!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see... So you were a long-lived sage. I did sense an extraordinary aura about you」

name: Paqy
message: 「Same goes for you」

name: Helena
message: 「Grandma, how about a refill of black tea?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, thank you. Gulp...」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!? Helena-san, since when were you there!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That isn't the black tea Misa brewed, is it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ugh...!? Y-You tricked me, Helena... You put rum in the tea...!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehehe, getting tricked is your own blunder」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-If I drink rum, I'll... ngh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Melilot-san!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, Misa-chan, head on home before it gets late. I'll be taking Melilot home with me♪」
